name: BWC Turkey Day Tourney
notes: A sixteen-man single-elimination tournament crowning the first BWC World Heavyweight Champion; Missile upsets tournament favorite Armageddon en route, and Gravedigger beats the Rowdy One in the final after a screwjob interference angle involving the operator's own on-screen President character, Ryan Vaughn.

name: BWC Monday Night Blast Off / Blast Zone
notes: The fed's own first televised weekly show, in two hour-long segments, opening three concurrent tournaments (US Iron Man, Great Lakes Iron Man, World Tag Team) and debuting "The Scotsman" Simon MacKnyght with a 27-second pinfall upset over the previously-dominant Armageddon. Carries a cleared memorial near-miss (a real-world WWF namecheck ad-lib during the broadcast, not the watched character phrase).
